title: Excellent stock pot!
text: Excellent stock pot!. This is my new favorite stockpot. Non-stick, heats evenly (I have a gas stove) and after using and washing at least 1/2 a dozen times, the pot still looks like new. The non-stick service does not scratch easily (no scratches at all yet) and the light green color does not flake (like I said, looks like new). If I had any complaint, it would be I wish I had gotten this in a larger size (not big enough for large portions), but that is my problem as I didn't realize how big 4 quarts is. Highly recommend to all chefs and would make a great shower/housewarming gift.

product_metadata.title: Phantom Chef 4.4 QT Casserole | Stockpot | Aluminum Body Non-Stick Ceramic Coating | With Soft Touch Stay Cool Handle | Dishwasher Safe | Non-Toxic PFOA & PTFE Free Pan | Color Black
features: HIGH QUALITY NON STICKING FOR HOME CHEFS - Made with premium aluminum and a nontoxic PFOA and PTFE free nonstick ceramic pan coating, our BPA free cooking casserole provides proper heat distribution and even cooking with less environmental impact.

COLORFUL SOPHISTICATED DESIGN - Our sleek easy to clean casserole combine fun and function. Pick your favorite glossy finish or mix and match with other Phantom Chef products to elevate the look of your kitchen and express your sense of style.

COOL-TOUCH HANDLES - Each lightweight stockpot features heat-resistant ergonomic handles that’re easy to grip and keeps hands and fingers safe. The hole at the end lets you easily display your colorful nonstick frying casserole or hang to dry.

COOK ALL YOUR FAVORITE DISHES - This stockpot is safe for all stove tops including gas, induction, electric, halogen, and ceramic. It is the perfect ceramic nonstick cookware set for your family's favorites.

DURABLE AND FASHIONABLE - Phantom Chef pots and pans are strong enough to withstand regular everyday use without sacrificing comfort or style. They can be maintained with regular hand washing with soap and water.
